Referral Note

I am referring Mrs. Alvarez, a 36-year-old elementary school teacher, for psychiatric evaluation of poor sleep and ongoing anxiety since a serious motor vehicle accident six months ago. Her orthopedic injuries from the accident have healed, but her symptoms have gradually worsened and are now affecting her work and her family life. She has no previous psychiatric history. She takes ibuprofen as needed. Thank you for seeing her.

Behavioral Observations (on arrival)

Appearance: Appears fatigued and anxious.

Behavior: Cooperative throughout the interview. Her husband drove her to the appointment.

Speech: Soft but coherent.

Mood / Affect: Mood "constantly on edge." Affect constricted.

Thought / Perception: Thought processes logical. Denies hallucinations and delusions. Denies suicidal and homicidal ideation.

Cognition / Insight: Insight and judgment intact.
